record.mcp_notes: Firecrawl provides an official MCP server at https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp with support for keyless access, account sign-in, or API key authentication. The MCP server allows connecting Firecrawl to AI tools via the Model Context Protocol.

raw_extraction.description: Firecrawl is an API service that allows searching the web, scraping any page, and interacting with it through one API. It provides LLM-ready output such as clean markdown, structured JSON, and screenshots, handling proxies, anti-bot, JavaScript rendering, and dynamic content. It is built for production with high uptime and consistent results, optimized for high throughput, and supports an MCP server to connect to AI tools via the Model Context Protocol.
raw_extraction.api_breadth: The API supports web search, scraping URLs with multiple output formats (markdown, HTML, structured JSON), interaction with scraped pages (click, fill forms, extract dynamic content), and session management (start, interact, stop). SDKs are available for Python, Node.js, and CLI.
raw_extraction.mcp_notes: Firecrawl provides an official MCP server at https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp with support for keyless access, account sign-in, or API key authentication. The MCP server allows connecting Firecrawl to AI tools via the Model Context Protocol.
raw_extraction.buildability_rationale: The API is well documented with examples in multiple languages (Python, Node.js, CLI, cURL). Authentication can be none for limited use or bearer token for higher rate limits. The MCP server is officially supported with clear setup instructions. SDKs and CLI tools facilitate integration and development.

No account or API key is required for this request. cURL # No API key needed to get started — add -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIRECRAWL_API_KEY" for higher rate limits: curl -s -X POST "https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/scrape" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "url": "https://firecrawl.dev", "formats": ["markdown", "html"] }' Add an API key when you need higher limits. See the Python SDK , Node SDK , or API reference to build it into your application. ​ Other ways to get started ​ Install the Firecrawl CLI One command installs the Firecrawl CLI, authenticates in your browser, and adds skills to every detected coding agent. npx -y firecrawl-cli@latest init --all --browser Restart your coding agent after setup so it can discover the new skills. See CLI for the full setup. ​ Set up with an agent Provide your agent with this Firecrawl setup prompt, or see all MCP setup options . For AI agents: Use llms.txt for an index of the documentation, or llms-full.txt for the full text. ​ Build and test directly Get your API key Create a free account for direct API access and higher limits Try it in the Playground Test Firecrawl in the browser without writing code ​ What can Firecrawl do? Search Search the web and get full page content from results Scrape Extract content from any URL as markdown, HTML, or structured JSON Interact Continue working with any scraped page: click, fill forms, extract dynamic content ​ Why Firecrawl? LLM-ready output : Clean markdown, structured JSON, screenshots, and more. Handles the hard stuff : Proxies, anti-bot, JavaScript rendering, and dynamic content. Reliable : Built for production with high uptime and consistent results. Fast : Results in seconds, optimized for high throughput. MCP Server : Connect Firecrawl to any AI tool via the Model Context Protocol . See the Search feature docs for all options. Copy page Copy page Choose how the connection will authenticate. Signing in and adding an API key are two paths to the same access: both reach the full tool surface on your team’s plan. Try Instantly No account or key. Search, Scrape, and Parse within daily limits. Start keyless setup Sign in Browser sign-in from Codex, Claude Code, or your favorite harness. Connect account Use an API key Configure an API key in your client, no browser needed. Configure an API key ​ Add an API key Create a Firecrawl API key , then add it as a bearer token in your client config: { "mcpServers" : { "firecrawl" : { "type" : "http" , "url" : "https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp" , "headers" : { "Authorization" : "Bearer <FIRECRAWL_API_KEY>" } } } } Configure the key through an environment variable or your client’s secret storage, never in the MCP URL. This is a server URL for your MCP client, not a page to open directly in a browser. Sign-in connections use https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp-oauth instead, and your client starts the browser flow. ​ Client setup For Agents Start keyless or use an API key. For Humans Sign in via browser. Next: choose a tool or run the server locally .
